decision.rationale: Preference minimizes Cars MAE degradation first, then critical-segment regression and worst-fold degradation, among stable treatments retaining at least 70% of the full augmentation's Yoad MAE gain. Pooled MAE is not the selection key.

subset_selection.method: nested proportional allocation by normalized manufacturer, exact model year, and full-Yoad mileage decile; SHA-256 predictor/position rank within stratum
